findings.location: Paragraph quoting Philippians 1:10 (source.html first paragraph containing Philippians 1:10)
findings.source_quote: "That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere (pure) and without offense till the day of Christ" (Philippians 1:10).
findings.suggested_fix: Render the phrase "approve things that are excellent" with a closer equivalent to the sense of 'approve' or 'recognize what is excellent' (rather than only 'membedakan apa yang utama') to preserve the evaluative nuance. For example: “Supaya kamu dapat menyetujui perkara-perkara yang utama/baik (apa yang utama), supaya kamu tulus (suci) dan tidak bercacat sampai pada hari Kristus.” Preserve original punctuation and parentheses around (pure) as in source.
findings.translation_quote: “Supaya kamu dapat membedakan apa yang utama, supaya kamu tulus (suci) dan tidak bercacat sampai pada hari Kristus” (Filipi 1:10).

findings.location: Paragraph discussing Satan perverting what God made (paragraph beginning "Remember, Satan has never invented a pleasure; he only takes what God made to be pure and good, perverts it, and offers it back in its perverted form.")
findings.source_quote: "Remember, Satan has never invented a pleasure; he only takes what God made to be pure and good, perverts it, and offers it back in its perverted form."
findings.suggested_fix: The translation uses the phrase "memperjalin keburukan" which is awkward and could obscure the intended meaning 'perverts it.' Suggest a clearer rendering such as “ia hanya mengambil apa yang Tuhan ciptakan murni dan baik, merusaknya, lalu menawarkannya kembali dalam bentuk yang tercemar.” Preserve sentence structure and emphasis.
findings.translation_quote: "Ingat, Setan tidak pernah menciptakan kenikmatan; ia hanya mengambil apa yang Tuhan ciptakan murni dan baik, memperjalin keburukan padanya, dan menawarkan kembali dalam bentuk yang tercemar."
